_comment: Recorded model responses served by ReplayLlmClient when no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set. Stored as raw strings, exactly as a model would return them. CVE-2099-10013 is a deliberate hallucination (wrong CVE ID) and CVE-2099-10014 is deliberately malformed, to demonstrate the Einstein Trust Layer.
CVE-2099-10009: {"recommendation":"accept","confidence":0.91,"rationale":"Justification identifies the specific vulnerable routine, shows it is unreachable (no XML parsing, verified by import audit and tracing), and adds compensating controls.","referencedCveId":"CVE-2099-10009"}
CVE-2099-10010: {"recommendation":"reject","confidence":0.94,"rationale":"'Not applicable' gives no reasoning about the vulnerable applet, its reachability, or compensating controls.","referencedCveId":"CVE-2099-10010"}
CVE-2099-10011: {"recommendation":"escalate","confidence":0.62,"rationale":"The maintainer explicitly states they have not confirmed whether untrusted archives can reach the vulnerable path. A human needs to verify the artifact trust boundary.","referencedCveId":"CVE-2099-10011"}
CVE-2099-10012: {"recommendation":"accept","confidence":0.58,"rationale":"Static regex patterns reduce ReDoS exposure, but the justification does not address whether request data is matched against those patterns.","referencedCveId":"CVE-2099-10012"}
CVE-2099-10013: {"recommendation":"accept","confidence":0.88,"rationale":"Network segmentation and host-key pinning mitigate the man-in-the-middle vector described in the advisory.","referencedCveId":"CVE-2099-31337"}
CVE-2099-10015: {"recommendation":"accept","confidence":0.93,"rationale":"Vulnerable class is removed at build time with a runtime assertion, and egress denial blocks the exploitation callback.","referencedCveId":"CVE-2099-10015"}
CVE-2099-10016: {"recommendation":"accept","confidence":0.89,"rationale":"Runtime evidence (ldd and process memory maps) shows the vulnerable library is never loaded; remediation of the unused package is tracked.","referencedCveId":"CVE-2099-10016"}
CVE-2099-10017: {"recommendation":"reject","confidence":0.9,"rationale":"Asserting a false positive without evidence about the installed perl version or vulnerable module does not address the CVE.","referencedCveId":"CVE-2099-10017"}
CVE-2099-10018: {"recommendation":"accept","confidence":0.84,"rationale":"Kerberos is unconfigured and no GSSAPI modules are loaded, so the vulnerable code is not reachable.","referencedCveId":"CVE-2099-10018"}
